title: 第394章 破阵子第393章 再见叶欣诚
slug: 长生从守书阁的太监开始
lines: 第394章破阵子
最终，他的目光定格在茶馆边上那张空着的、只坐了刘锋和小女孩的方桌上——那是茶馆掌柜念在刘锋时常来此唱曲、能招揽些生意，又见他带着个孩子可怜，特意给他留的固定位置，平日里即便客满，也很少有人会去坐。
叶欣诚迈开步子，靴子踏在地板上，发出沉稳的“嗒、嗒”声。
所有人的目光都随着他的移动而移动，心中惊疑不定：这位煞星捕头，找这跛脚卖唱的穷小子作甚？
刘锋在叶欣诚进门时，就已放下了茶碗，低眉顺眼地坐着，一只手轻轻按在身边有些不安的小女孩肩头，示意她别怕。
直到叶欣诚走到桌前站定，投下的阴影将他笼罩，他才缓缓抬起头，脸上是惯常的那种平静中带着些许拘谨和卑微的神色，微微欠身：“大人。”
叶欣诚没有立刻说话，只是居高临下地打量着刘锋，目光在他洗得发白的短褂、过于宽大的旧棉袄、跛着的腿，以及那张虽然脏污却难掩清秀的少年脸庞上停留了片刻，尤其是在他怀中那把旧二胡上多看了两眼。
“方才那首《破阵子》，是你写的？”
叶欣诚开口，声音不大，却带着一种金石般的质感，清晰传入每个人耳中。
“回大人话，是过路的好人可怜小子，赠送的。”
刘锋低眉顺眼地回答。
“是吗？你好运气，唱的也不错，没埋没了。”
“多谢大人谬赞。”
刘锋依旧低着头。
“除了这《破阵子》，还会唱别的词么？”
叶欣诚似乎来了些谈兴，竟在刘锋对面的长凳上坐了下来。
掌柜的连忙亲自小跑过来，用袖子飞快地擦了擦本就干净的桌面，赔着笑脸：“叶爷，您喝点什么？上好的普洱刚沏上……”
“不必。”
叶欣诚抬手止住，目光依旧落在刘锋身上。
刘锋沉默了一下，似乎在思考，然后才谨慎地答道：“回大人，小子走街串巷，胡乱学了些俚曲小调，也会几首前人词牌，多是些……登不得大雅之堂的。”
“哦？都会哪些词牌？”
叶欣诚追问。
“《鹧鸪天》、《蝶恋花》、《临江仙》……还有一些说唱的本子。”刘锋报了几个常见的词牌名。
“《水调歌头》可会？”
叶欣诚忽然问道。
刘锋闻言，脸上适时地露出一丝为难和窘迫，摇了摇头，声音更低了些：“《水调歌头》？小子……唱不来那等委婉深致、意境悠长的调子。
平日里混口饭吃，多唱些热闹通俗的，或是带点故事的。”
叶欣诚听了，不置可否，只是又看了刘锋一眼，那目光似乎更深邃了些。
“无妨。县令高大人近日案牍劳形，听闻你曲唱得别致，想听听解闷。跟我走一趟吧。”
此言一出，不仅刘锋懵了，连茶馆里暗中竖着耳朵的众人也都是一惊！
他对着叶欣诚深深一揖：“是，大人。能得县令大人和叶捕头青眼，是小子的造化。”
content_en:
Chapter 394 Breaking the Array
Finally, his eyes were fixed on the empty square table next to the teahouse where only Liu Feng and the little girl were sitting - that was a fixed seat specially reserved for Liu Feng by the teahouse owner because he thought Liu Feng would often come here to sing and attract some business. He also saw that he had a child and felt sorry for him. Even if it was full on weekdays, few people would sit there.
Ye Xincheng stepped forward, his boots hitting the floor with a steady "ta, ta" sound.
Everyone's eyes followed his movements, and they were filled with surprise and uncertainty: What did this evil star want to do with this poor lame singing boy?
Liu Feng had already put down his tea bowl when Ye Xincheng came in. He sat with a low eyebrow and gently pressed his hand on the shoulder of the uneasy little girl next to him, telling her not to be afraid.
It wasn't until Ye Xincheng walked to the table and stood still, with the shadow cast over him, that he slowly raised his head, with his usual calm expression with a hint of restraint and humility on his face, and bowed slightly: "Sir."
Ye Xincheng did not speak immediately, but looked at Liu Feng condescendingly, his eyes lingering for a moment on his washed-white short coat, his too-large old cotton-padded jacket, his lame legs, and the young man's face that was dirty but could not hide his beauty, especially the old erhu in his arms.
"Did you write the song "Broken Array" just now?"
Ye Xincheng spoke, his voice was not loud, but it carried a gold-stone-like texture that clearly reached everyone's ears.
"To tell you what, my lord, it was a gift from a nice guy who passed by and took pity on the boy."
Liu Feng answered with a low eyebrow.
"Really? You're lucky, you can sing well and you're not buried."
"Thank you for your compliment, sir."
Liu Feng still lowered his head.
"Besides this "Broken Array", will you sing any other lyrics?"
Ye Xincheng seemed to be having some conversation, and actually sat down on the bench opposite Liu Feng.
The shopkeeper hurriedly ran over in person, quickly wiped the already clean tabletop with his sleeves, and said with a smile: "Master Ye, what do you want to drink? The best Pu'er has just been brewed..."
"No need."
Ye Xincheng raised his hand to stop, his eyes still falling on Liu Feng.
Liu Feng was silent for a moment, seeming to be thinking, and then replied cautiously: "Sir, I walked around the streets and randomly learned some slang songs and tunes. I also know a few ancient lyrics, but most of them are... not worthy of being refined."
"Oh? What word cards do you know?"
Ye Xincheng asked.
""Partridge Sky", "Die Lianhua", "Linjiang Fairy"... and some rap books." Liu Feng reported a few common lyrics.
"Can you know "Water Melody Songtou"?"
Ye Xincheng suddenly asked.
When Liu Feng heard this, a trace of embarrassment appeared on his face at the right time. He shook his head and said in a lower voice: ""Shui Tiao Ge Tou"? This kid... can't sing such a tactful and profound tune with a long artistic conception.
On weekdays, I usually eat and drink, and sing more lively and popular songs, or songs with some stories. "
After hearing this, Ye Xincheng did not comment, but looked at Liu Feng again, and his gaze seemed to be deeper.
"It's okay. The county magistrate, Mr. Gao, has been busy with paperwork recently. I heard that you sang a unique song and wanted to listen to it to relieve your boredom. Come with me."
As soon as these words came out, not only Liu Feng was stunned, but also everyone in the teahouse who secretly pricked their ears were shocked!
He bowed deeply to Ye Xincheng and said, "Yes, sir. It is the boy's destiny to win the favor of the county magistrate and Mr. Ye."
